Sound library

Patches & patterns

Hit Audition to hear a patch play a short phrase right on this page — no need to open the synth first. When you find one you like, “Load in synth” drops it straight into the Filament One with every knob set for you.

Factory patches

Eight starting points covering basses, leads, keys and pads. Each one is just a set of synth parameters — nothing is sampled.

Rhythm patterns

Drop a beat into the step sequencer. The dotted grid below previews the drum hits; load it to also bring across the tempo and synth line.

Make your own

Dial in a sound in the synth and hit “Save patch” — it’s stored right in your browser, ready next time.
